result.stdout:
Nap — API testing tool

Usage:
  nap run <file|folder>                     Run a .nap file, .naplist playlist, or folder
  nap check <file>                          Validate a .nap or .naplist file
  nap generate openapi <spec> --output-dir <dir>  Generate .nap files from OpenAPI spec
  nap convert http <file|dir> --output-dir <dir>  Convert .http files to .nap format
  nap lsp                                   Run the language server (LSP 3.17 over stdio)
  nap help                                  Show this help

Options:
  --env <name>              Environment name (loads .napenv.<name>)
  --env-file <path>         Path to http-client.env.json (for convert)
  --var <key=value>         Variable override (repeatable)
  --output <format>         Output: pretty (default), junit, json, ndjson
  --output-dir <dir>        Output directory for generate/convert commands
  --dry-run                 Preview without writing files (convert command)
  --verbose                 Enable debug-level logging
